Subject: Finsight pilot — recap + proposed next steps

Hi Emily / John —

Thanks again for taking time today to walk through Finsight's latency-sensitive inference needs. Quick recap from our side and suggested next steps so we can keep momentum: 

- Goal: run a 6-week pilot to validate throughput and SLOs for your streaming alerting workload (avg seq len ~320 tokens).
- Success criteria: <10% tail latency above 350ms at 95th percentile; 15% token cost improvement vs your current baseline; no functional regressions on the top-10 prompts.
- Proposed pilot scope: 2 models (open LLM + quantized variant), dedicated capacity for peak testing, upfront baseline run, then 4 weeks of production-like traffic.
- Timing: we can start baseline within 2 business weeks once SOW is signed and an ingress endpoint is provisioned.

I've attached a one-page pilot proposal and a rough SOW draft for procurement to review. Can you confirm these items for your side? Specifically: (1) will procurement need a PO or a signed SOW? (2) do you have internal legal comments we should expect? (3) who on your infra team should we loop to provision endpoint/network?

If it helps, I can carve out 30 minutes tomorrow to walk procurement through the SOW. Proposed times: Mon 10:00–10:30 PT or Tue 14:00–14:30 PT.

Thanks,
Rafael

Rafael Mendes
